title: "step_10 — USA results"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Purpose.** Report the USA paired endpoints.

```{r}
meta <- fread(file.path(QDJ_ROOT, "output_us", "us_meta.csv"))
pe <- fread(file.path(QDJ_ROOT, "output_us", "us_paired_e1.csv"))
nb_assert(all(c("E1", "E2") %in% meta$endpoint), "endpoints missing")
knitr::kable(data.table(
  endpoint = meta$endpoint,
  n = meta$n,
  median_dBrier = round(meta$median_delta, 6),
  ci = sprintf("[%.6f, %.6f]", meta$boot_lo, meta$boot_hi),
  sign = sprintf("%d/%d", meta$sign_k, meta$sign_n),
  p = round(meta$sign_p, 3),
  median_dAUC = round(meta$median_dauc, 4)
), caption = "USA: paired SSI-3 vs SSI-3+queue")
```

`[measurement]` The USA pilot reproduces the India null: no calibrated-probability
gain, a small ranking gain. Only 21 reservoirs have paired test-window
predictions, so this is a pilot, not a confirmatory test.
